issues.description: The script creates hidden iframes, which can be used for data extraction or clickjacking, though in this case it appears unused for malicious purposes.
issues.recommendation: Remove unnecessary hidden iframe creation unless required for functionality.

issues.description: The script reads and writes to localStorage for settings and popup dismissal state. No sensitive data is stored, but localStorage is used.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive, non-personal data is stored in localStorage.

issues.description: The script does not use any network requests (fetch, GM_xmlhttpRequest, WebSocket, etc.) to transmit data externally.
No use of eval, new Function, or dynamic script injection detected.
No code obfuscation detected. The script is readable and not minified or obfuscated.

summary: The script does not transmit data externally, does not collect sensitive information, and does not execute remote code. It uses localStorage for settings and popup state, and creates a hidden iframe (not used for malicious purposes). No obfuscation, DOM XSS, or supply chain risks detected. Overall, the script is safe with minor privacy and iframe risks.
